## Defect — reused IDs

Each ID below names **two or more different rows** in `OPEN.md`. The
tally beside it is counted from the source, not asserted. All-closed is
a naming collision only; **two open rows is a sync defect**, because
one `td:` id cannot link two rows and the register cannot tell them
apart. `D17` forbids renumbering to close a *gap*; a *collision* is the
opposite case and needs the owner's ruling on which one gets a new
number.

- `O23` — 1 closed, 1 open
- `O24` — 2 closed, 0 open
- `O25` — 1 closed, 1 open
